Text: Subject: Reconnecting  Hi Callie!  I know we haven't spoken in a while! I moved but I am back in the area, I'm reaching out from the California Department of Insurance to let you know that your zip code has been identified as wildfire-distressed area. I'm sure you already know this but these are communities here wildfire risk is high, insurance coverage can be harder to access, and FAIR Plan enrollment is elevated. The Department uses a statewide methodology that looks at wildfire hazard, FAIR Plan concentration, and affordability concerns to identify these ZIP codes. We would welcome the opportunity to connect with your office about outreach materials, a presentation, or a webinar to help ensure constituents have the information they need to understand their coverage options. Reaching consumers directly is essential, especially in areas facing heightened insurance challenges, and we want to support your office in providing clear, accessible guidance. If helpful, we can also tailor the discussion to the ZIP codes within your area.  Thank you!!  Andrea Valdes  Outreach Analyst  Community Relations & Outreach Branch  Cell: (213) 514-4658  CONFIDENTIALITY NOTICE: This communication may contain confidential and/or legally privileged information.
